To assess whether a FRIA is necessary, the following information is required: 

1. The role of the entity under the AI Act (whether it is a deployer or provider).
2. The categorization of the AI system as high-risk based on the criteria established in Articles 6 and 27.
3. Whether there is a valid exception or exemption for its use-case as outlined in Articles 6 and 27.

This assessment helps determine if a FRIA is required before deploying a high-risk AI system.
